phases.title: The observability foundation
phases.summary: The starting workspace connected agent telemetry to traces, incident detection, evidence-based investigation, and a dashboard.

phases.title: A reproducible local stack
phases.summary: Container setup made the workspace repeatable, with authenticated access, health checks, durable storage, and measured acceptance results.

phases.title: AgentScope in your terminal
phases.summary: An installable REPL brought investigation into the terminal. Homebrew packaging and portable command aliases made installation more consistent.

phases.title: An independent public site
phases.summary: The landing page became a standalone static site that can deploy to Vercel without the API, database, or dashboard credentials.

phases.title: A lighter product experience
phases.summary: The public pages adopted an ivory and amber palette, clearer spacing, and responsive layouts for desktop and mobile.

phases.title: A practical getting-started guide
phases.summary: A professional README and public documentation explain the product, local setup, CLI, SDK, and investigation workflow with real terminal captures.

phases.title: A visible development history
phases.summary: The Phase section connects each development step to its date, purpose, and source commit, making the evolution of AgentScope easy to follow.

phases.title: Monitoring starts in your project
phases.summary: Install AgentScope, start watch from an existing repository, and open a local dashboard with live runtime telemetry. Project setup and local services are prepared automatically.
